# Fit on a Sphere

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

With x = \[3, -1, 1, ...\] (6 elements), y = \[2, 2, 4, ...\] (6 elements), z = \[3, 3, 3, ...\] (6 elements), Run displays center = \[1, 2, 3\], radius = 2.

## What this example demonstrates

With x = \[3, -1, 1, ...\] (6 elements), y = \[2, 2, 4, ...\] (6 elements), z = \[3, 3, 3, ...\] (6 elements), Run displays center = \[1, 2, 3\], radius = 2.
